description: Open-toe slides with three parallel straps and sparkling trim.

images.en: There is poetry in an ordinary afternoon.
images.alt: WOOOHU 9339-19 sparkling multi-strap slides, collection photograph 1

images.zh: 一点欢喜，便能点亮一天。
images.alt: WOOOHU 9339-19 sparkling multi-strap slides, collection photograph 3

images.en: Let the light find you where you are.
images.alt: WOOOHU 9339-19 sparkling multi-strap slides, collection photograph 4

images.en: A slower moment can open a wider world.
images.zh: 慢下一刻，世界便宽一点。
images.alt: WOOOHU 9339-19 sparkling multi-strap slides, collection photograph 5

images.en: Keep a little brightness for yourself.
images.alt: WOOOHU 9339-19 sparkling multi-strap slides, collection photograph 6
